messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time data, so I can’t give you the exact current time in New York City right now. If you need the precise time, you could check a reliable world‑clock website or your device’s clock set to the “America/New York” time zone.

But we might need to use a function? There's no function for time. We can compute based on UTC? But we don't know current UTC. We could respond that we don't have real-time capability.
